f8s.advantageDescription: Hithium offers an integrated three-phase solar-storage solution, supporting 6~15 kW inverter + 8~256 kWh battery configurable capacity.
f8s.cycleLifeDescription: Long cycle life LFP battery with grid-proven cells, ≥8000 cycle lifespan and low heat generation for superior safety and durability.
f8s.flexibleCapacityDescription: Our product features an 8kWh per pack modular design, allowing for each cluster (stack) to have a capacity ranging from 8 - 32kWh. Moreover, you can parallel multiple units up to a total capacity of 256kWh, providing you with highly flexible and scalable energy storage solutions to meet various power needs.
f8s.weatherConditionsDescription: IP65 rated. Withstands 40cm water immersion, superior water resistance.

f8s.summary: High-voltage three-phase solar-storage solution from 8kWh to 256kWh.
